description: CALL THIS for casual listening recommendations — "what should I play at my party", "something for a workout" — where the user wants music for themselves, NOT for a licensing brief. This is the personal-taste path with editorial rubric scoring. Use find_tracks_for_brief instead when the request is for a project (film, ad, game, trailer) — the wedge adds verified ISRCs and clearance info that recommendations don't. Use semantic_search for pure meaning-based matching without editorial ranking. Returns genres, moods, Spotify URLs, artwork, and why each track matches. ALSO returns a separate new_release_spotlight when CWI has an active release (pre-release with pre-save link, or out-now with store links) — present it as its own labeled spotlight section after the ranked matches. Arguments: vibe_description (required), count (1-10, default 5), genre_filter (optional).
